prior_summary: Swap-topology buffer prior implemented as a learned DDPM action policy: causal state history is encoded with explicit red-in-blue-goal, blue-in-red-goal and red-buffered geometric features; trainable heads predict the temporary red buffer placement and red-buffered predicate; those predictions condition the action diffusion backbone.
applicable_conditions: Use when the red block starts in or near the lower region that is the future blue goal, the blue block occupies the upper red-goal region, and the central tabletop buffer around world x=-0.181 m, y near the midpoint of the two goal stripes is free. Inputs are the state channels only: qpos/qvel, tcp_pose, red_pose, blue_pose, red_goal and blue_goal in world metres/quaternion components.
termination_guidance: The useful exit state is topological: red_pose has settled on the tabletop near the central buffer, blue_pose remains near the upper/red-goal region, the gripper is open during the retreat after release or is entering the overlapping approach/closing phase on blue, and the TCP has moved from high above the buffer toward the blue block. The inference API may transfer after red_buffered is clear and the successor can see open or closing fingers near blue.
limitations: The model does not implement IK, collision constraints, image perception, or a scripted controller. The buffer x location is encoded from the demonstrated world-frame prior rather than discovered by planning, and robustness to an occupied buffer or large unseen goal rearrangements is not demonstrated. Auxiliary labels use only causal current observations and short-horizon future observations available in training batches; at deployment no future labels are used.

config.architecture: Conditional 1D U-Net DDPM backbone with learned state/topology encoder
config.normalization: uses the assignment shared normalizer fitted on complete original demonstrations; no per-skill scale fitting
